clips.send: Send this to someone who thinks you can only leave a secret society in disgrace - awe at a line actually being drawn.
clips.caption:
He agreed with their goal. He left anyway.

Inside the group he once belonged to, the stated purpose wasn't secret or shocking - end hunger, end starvation, end poverty across the planet. Something almost anyone would sign onto.

What he couldn't accept was the method they planned to use to get there. He's never said he disagreed with where they wanted to go. Only with how they intended to force everyone else to arrive.

That's the part nobody talks about when they imagine a secret society: sometimes the goal sounds good. It's the methodology that should scare you.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the part of the plan he actually walked away from.
